title: Elitewheels Drive G36 performance gravel carbon wheels
notes: Official specification table: hooked reduced-hook bead, 36 mm depth, 25 mm inner and 31 mm outer width, 1,325 ±30 g pair without tubeless valves and rim tape (both listed as installed), 125 kg limit including rider, bike, gear and accessories, Kinetic hub with two 50T (7.2°) star ratchets and TPI steel bearings, Sapim CX-Ray spokes 21F/24R, Center Lock, 12x100/12x142 mm, compatible tires 700x28-65C and recommended 30-40C. US$1,189 on the official direct store. No maximum tire pressure or mainland China price is published.
